content: If your condition does not improve after three days of treatment or persists for more than seven days, inform your doctor immediately. Additionally, if the infection recurs within two months, notify your doctor. Possible side effects of this medication include burning, itching, or pain in the vaginal or urethral area, as well as lower abdominal cramps. If your doctor has prescribed this medication, it is because they have determined that the benefits outweigh the potential risks of side effects. Severe allergic reactions to this medication are rare. However, this is not an exhaustive list of potential side effects. In the United States, contact your doctor for medical advice regarding side effects. In Canada, consult your doctor for similar concerns. Before using this medication, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you are allergic to it, to other azole antifungal agents (such as terconazole or fluconazole), or if you have any other allergies. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could cause allergic reactions or other issues. Consult your doctor about whether it is safe to engage in sexual intercourse while using this product. Be aware that this medication may weaken rubber products such as latex condoms, diaphragms, or cervical caps, potentially leading to failure and resulting in pregnancy. Avoid using these products during treatment with this medication. Do not use this medication for self-treatment if you are pregnant. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used when clearly necessary. If you are pregnant, follow your doctor’s instructions on how to use the applicator to insert the medication. It is not known whether this drug passes into breast milk. Drug interactions may alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not include all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal products, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. If someone has overdosed on this medication and exhibits serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. To help prevent vaginal yeast infections, thoroughly dry the genital area after showering, bathing, or swimming. Avoid wearing tight jeans, nylon underwear, pantyhose, wet bathing suits, or damp/sweaty exercise clothes for extended periods. If you miss a dose, use it as soon as you remember. If it is near the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. Store this medication at room temperature. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. This information is a summary and does not contain all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that this product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs.
